name: Final Battle Music
doc: Final Battle Music (Griever's enemy attack 368, its only user): it draws nothing - a cue task's 36-tick script: the music's volume transition, the final battle music (an exe block: a sample bank and an AKAO score) handed to the victory fanfare player and a wait for it, the camera track and the caster's chain transformation, the music channel volume, the damage. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag344_griever_368.cpp) run on the program's memory (its queues, pools and packet arenas in the module); it has no file (its loader is the engine's empty one).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Cues
parts.doc: It draws nothing: a cue task's script - the music's volume transition at its first tick, the final battle music handed to the victory fanfare player (an exe block: a sample bank and an AKAO score, song id 0x5B), a wait for it, the camera track and the caster's chain transformation, the music channel volume command and the damage (the first target of action 0), the end

params.label: Volume tick
params.doc: The music's volume transition (Music_SetVolumeTrans) at this tick of the cue task

params.label: Fanfare tick
params.doc: The fanfare block handed to the victory fanfare player (BS_R0win_QueueVictoryFanfare) at this tick

params.label: Wait tick
params.doc: At this tick the cue task waits (its counter kept) until the fanfare player is done

params.label: Camera tick
params.doc: The camera track and the caster's chain transformation at this tick

params.label: Channel volume tick
params.doc: The music channel volume command (BS_Music_SetChannelVolumeCommand) at this tick

params.label: Damage tick
params.doc: The action result of action 0's first target at this tick

params.label: End tick
params.doc: The cue task's last tick (the effect ends with it)

params.label: Channel: volume
params.doc: Its second argument: the volume (the game's 127)

params.label: Chain transformation
params.doc: The caster's chain transformation (its animation sequence) queued at the camera tick

params.label: Camera track
params.doc: The camera track played at the camera tick (any length: its offsets are its own)

not_editable.label: Final battle music
not_editable.doc: The block handed to the victory fanfare player: {2, offsets, end} - a sample bank (AKAO) and the score (AKAO, song id 0x5B: the music the PC plays), 140 KB: its first 4096 bytes shown
